chapter_title: Concerning the Five Saviours, the Resurrectors of
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶3:** The second rest oring principle is [ * too fragmentary to translate; presumably a distinct mode by which the Divine raises what has fallen into spiritual death* ].

**¶4:** The third power of restoration is the Divine Love itself , the Origin from which all else proceeds — for through Divine Truth going forth from that Love, all living affections and interior perceptions that had been scattered into disorder are gathered back into unity , returning into conjunction with their Source , where they receive the full ness of what they had l acked and enter into the heav enly peace that belongs to those whose goods and truths are restored to order.

**¶5:** The fourth rest oring principle is Divine Wisdom as it flows into and illuminates the understanding — for it is this infl ux of light into the rational mind that [ *raises what was dead in ignor ance into the life of perception ; remainder too fragmentary to render *].

**¶6:** The fifth power of restoration toward all who are in the good of charity is the Divine Love itself in its eternal and imm ov able const ancy. It sust ains every spiritual faculty in the soul , and it stands un shaken at the center of all interior order . It opens the interior sight of those fac ulties — removing the ve ils of obsc urity that had covered them — and draws them into conjunction with itself through the attractive power of love according to the Divine purpose . It raises them up and establ ishes them in living spiritual states , and they ab ide there in perman ence until [ *the text breaks ; presumably: until the full restoration of all things into their final heav enly order *].

---

*Note on method : * " Resurre ctor" throughout is rendered as ** rest oring principle ** or **power of restoration** — the spiritual reality being not bod ily rising but the successive stages by which the Divine raises aff ections and perceptions from spiritual death ( fals ity, disorder , separation ) back into spiritual life (truth , order, conjunction ). The progression from one resurre ctor to the next corresponds to discrete and ordered degrees of this restoration, moving from more exterior to more interior operations — culmin ating in the Divine Love itself drawing all fac ulties into permanent conjunction .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The second resurrector is [Jesus the Splendour, for he descends to those who have fallen into the darkness, and by his knowledge he awakens them from the sleep of death].
And the third resurrector is the Father, the First [Greatness], because by his word shall all lives [that were scattered] gather in and go to him, and they receive [joy] and rest.

The fourth resurrector is the Light Mind, because [he enters into the understanding of the soul and illuminates it, and raises up the knowledge that was dead in ignorance into the life of perception].

The fifth resurrector to the good [of all souls] is the Father, the First established one [in the land of Light]. [He sustains] all the powers, and he stands firm [in his greatness]. He shall unveil the [Light] over them [and illuminate them], and he draws them to him [by the power of love], his will [prevailing over all], and he [raises] them, and he stands them up [in rest] there, and they remain until [the consummation of all things].
